text:
evan: Quick sync — can we finalize the rollout rules for the new price sheet canary? Need signoff on grandfathering, small-credit auto-apply, and partner flow.

nina: Proposal: grandfather subscriptions created before T0 and active on T0. Exclude trials and accounts created during the canary window.

harry: Ops notes: for reconciled invoices we should default to credit memos applied to next invoice. Refunds only if invoice paid < 10 days and credit < $100.

sylvia: Marketplace customers: we don't touch partner invoices. Tag rows `partner_passthrough=true` and hand off CSV to partner-ops. Offer a platform promo up to $25 for immediate relief.

evan: Agreed. Also need tax_country in export so tax can reconcile VAT/GST impacts.

harry: I'll run a tagging job and include columns: customer_id, invoice_id, estimated_credit_usd, tax_country, partner_passthrough, promo_issued. Quick SQL: ```sql
select id as customer_id from subscriptions where created_at < '2026-08-01' and status='active';
```

sylvia: Auto-credit thresholds: auto for estimated_credit < $150; escalate to finance review if >= $150 or tax_country in ['DE','FR'].

nina: Support copy: "If you qualify, an adjustment will appear on your next invoice. For partner-billed customers, a small promo may be applied while partner processes refunds."

evan: Action items: Harry run export (EOD) and tag `experiment_ab=canary`; Sylvia draft partner handoff template; Nina approve customer message.

billing-bot: Tagging job scheduled at 01:00 UTC. Will post export to https://internal.redwood/exports/2060001234-ab-canary-export.csv and notify #eng-billing on completion.

evan: Locking this plan at 16:00 PT if no objections. Please react with :+1: to sign off.
